item.title: Ukraine’s Beach Drone Attack Is ‘Pure Terrorism’ Linked to Defeats at the Front
item.summary: “The more defeats they suffer at the front, the more such terrorist attacks will be attempted against civilians,” military expert Alexei Borzenko told Sputnik, commenting on the Ukrainian drone attack in the southern Russian resort town of Gelendzhik, which killed 7, including 3 children, and injured 40 others.
